This is a source/camera projection gap, not an independently established physical size or missing mass: the plate supplies no wing depth, the owner-selected 8 m reconstruction remains, and a separate wall-corner-only camera experiment with geometry/focal held fixed moves the near roof apex about 74 px vertically. Under T-3153 this demonstrated camera-fit uncertainty is within tolerance; no historical station, new plan dimension or phase date is inferred.

The actual final comparison retains two upper main-gable openings and one attic opening, matching the visible categories above the separate annex. Earlier work already built those counts; no independently identified missing or miscounted opening remains.

The actual final comparison retains five upper front windows, four lower front windows and the central entrance. These were built by earlier merged work and are directly enrolled here without a new geometry/date claim.

The Shop-derived framing has a low eye and near-edge principal point. Fine corner, shared-surface raster and pixel offsets are within T-3153 tolerance. This is a diagnostic comparison camera and does not recover a historical visitor position or independent metric calibration.

Monochrome Andreas does not establish literal roof colour, shutter paint or photometric wall finish. Existing declared reconstruction and separate Wau-Bun white/bright-blue written evidence remain controlling. Related retrospective coloured copies supply no independent July pigment observation.

This flat-grade isolated group does not include application streets, terrain, people or surrounding buildings. Published body/ground/entrance/desktop/phone acceptance remains a separate root release check, not a claim made by this image verdict.
